prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, solid page background fill exactly #FDFCF8 (warm off-white paper — must match KursoKo assessment UI, NOT pure white #FFFFFF). Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Young SHS-age figure, young woman, warm light tan skin, hair in neat bun, loose creative hoodie #4B2C7F with charcoal drawstrings, yellow paint-smear cuff, scattered lavender paint-fleck dots, relaxed joggers #2D2D2D, canvas sneakers #2D2D2D. Pose: full body, seated at purple desk drawing pictures for a school handout — character looks down at paper on desk tilted toward their face. CRITICAL PROP ORIENTATION: handout paper illustrated side faces the CHARACTER; colored pencil marks the side facing them. Viewer sees the BLANK BACK of the paper, a steep paper edge, or hands from side angle — NEVER a flat front-facing house/illustration readable upright from camera (no reversed drawing toward viewer). Hero prop: handout page with simple abstract shapes only (no words). Supporting props: colored pencils in cup, eraser, ruler. Entire canvas filled with flat #FDFCF8 background plus thin grey floor line and faint grey decorative circles — NO text, NO letter, NO border frame, NO transparency. Subtle Artistic RIASEC accent #FFD54F on props and trim, #9575CD secondary accents. Cheerful creative energy. Full head-to-feet visible. Hands: exactly five fingers when visible.
